    Meet your next Galaxy Buds

    Dynamic wide-range speaker for rich, full audio

    White Galaxy Buds4 earbuds in close-up, showcasing the real metal blades in different angles. Scene changes and a person is wearing Galaxy Buds4 in White, facing the right.

    Iconic in metal. Shaped for all-day comfort

    Hear every layer come alive 1

    Super Clear Call, even in noise 2

    A pair of Galaxy Buds4 appear docked in the Charging Case. The lid of the Charging Case opens and spins clockwise, then the lid closes. The Charging Case is placed on a wireless charging pad which lights up as the battery indicator light on the case turns on.

    Designed for ease, crafted for beauty

    Iconic in metal. Shaped for all-day comfort

    Timeless colours for every tune

    A pair of white, Galaxy Buds4 docked in the Charging Case.3

    Designed for ease, crafted for beauty

    Check that Galaxy Buds4 is properly in place through the translucent cover. Charge wirelessly and simply take it anywhere — its compact, lightweight design makes it easy to carry. 3

    The skeleton view of Galaxy Buds4 is in the centre. As the ear shapes and wearing condition changes, Galaxy Buds4 is assembled. The earbuds fit into a person's ear, who is smiling and facing the left.4

    Let your music stay in place effortlessly

    Backed by global ear data, Galaxy Buds4 is shaped with a computational design that enhances wearability. Galaxy Buds4 stay snugly in your ears, whether you're indoors or outdoors. 4

    Fingers pinching and swiping the blade of a single, white Galaxy Buds4 showing the ease and convenience of using the Pinch Control feature. Nearby are icons that indicate the Pinch Control: Single Pinch, Double Pinch, Swipe, Pinch and Hold.

    Easy pinch, easy controls

    Now with the upgraded Pinch Control, you can manage your media or control the volume with just your index finger — no need to reach for your phone.

    Balanced clear sound, all around

    Dynamic wide-range speaker for rich, full audio

    Enjoy beautifully balanced sound on Galaxy Buds4 powered by an 11 mm wide-range speaker, delivering rich sound from solid, controlled bass to clear, detailed highs.

    Hear every layer come alive

    Hear every layer come alive with extended bit depth and high sampling rates. Samsung Seamless Codec (SSC) supports 24-bit / 96 kHz audio to preserve the original sound with vast amount of information, while optimised data transmission control enables a stable listening experience with reduced audible artefacts or dropouts. Turn on the Ultra High Quality Audio (UHQ) option on your Galaxy smartphone and rediscover your favourite songs in full detail.5

    Rich sound adjusted your way

    Take a step closer to stable, everyday audio. Customise bass, treble and tone with the 9-Band Equaliser to match your preference, creating a sound signature tailored just for you. Galaxy Buds4 also optimises sound adaptively to your ear shape and wearing style, ensuring a consistent listening experience as your ears perceive it — even when you adjust the volume.6

    Super Clear Call, even in noise

    Your voice is clearly captured by 6 microphones positioned around your head, intelligently isolating it from the background sound with advanced Deep Neural Network (DNN). The exceptionally clean voice signal is transmitted with pure effortlessness through Super Wideband (SWB) up to 16 kHz between your Galaxy Buds4 and Galaxy smartphone. Hear and be heard, loud and clear — even in noisy moments.7

    Surround yourself in sound

    Expand your soundstage from stereo into a grand orchestral hall or a large arena, placing you at the centre of a live performance with a single touch. Feel instruments and vocals in three dimensions, and experience the atmosphere enveloping you in music.8

    Deeper immersion that adapts with you

    Dive into your personal soundscape

    With its quality sound system, Galaxy Buds4 achieves precise noise control. Distractions fade in real-time as the Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) algorithm instantly processes and adapts to your ear shape and fit. Tune in to immersive sound wherever you are.

    Listen to music while staying connected

    Manage your listening experience your way. Galaxy Buds4 adjusts the levels of ANC and ambient sounds in real-time, adapting to your environment — whether you’re sensitive to noise or prefer more blending. Stay more immersed in the music while remaining connected to the world around you.

    Keep in sync with the Galaxy Ecosystem9

    Simple connection. Straight to the tunes

    Just open the Charging Case and you’re all set — as simple as that. No apps, no downloads and of course, no hassle. Your Galaxy smartphone and Galaxy Tab detect Galaxy Buds4 for easy pairing.10

    Now one in One UI

    The evolved One UI 8.5 creates a deep connection between your Galaxy Buds and Galaxy smartphone, almost like a duet. Control has never been more intuitive — manage features from the device settings, without downloading a separate app. From the Quick Panel, you can easily access features and also set and save sound preferences for each app.11

    Personal AI translator in your ear

    Break language barriers with a personal AI translator in your ear. Fully engage in the moment with Galaxy AI powered interpreter — hear it through Galaxy Buds4 and read it on your Galaxy smartphone. Galaxy AI steps in to ensure clear communication across different languages.12

    Your AI, hands-free

    Ask for assistance with just your voice ― no phone-pulling required. Simply speak to AI agents such as Bixby to get answers to questions or manage tasks instantly without slowing you down.13

    Just nod and shake

    Intuitive nods and shakes let you respond quickly, from answering calls to talking to Bixby, without lifting a hand. Get what you need effortlessly, even in situations where your hands are busy or when it’s not an ideal time to speak.14

    Switch instantly between Galaxy devices

    Auto Switch shifts your audio to the most pressing task at hand. Take a call on your Galaxy smartphone while focusing on your creative project on your Galaxy Tab or Galaxy Book. Jump right back to where you left off, the instant you hang up. The experience is seamless across your Galaxy devices.15

    ‎ ‎

    Pair up with our all-new AI phone

    Pair Galaxy S26 and S26+ with Galaxy Watch8 to your everyday life to spark excitement ― from listening to quality audio with an improved codec and stable Bluetooth 6.1 connection, to paying more attention to your sleep quality and cardio health.

    Galaxy S26 | S26+

    Frequently Asked Question

    Galaxy Buds4 features enhanced sound setup, including Samsung Seamless Codec (SSC) supporting up to 24-bit / 96 kHz and Super Clear Call feature making all your calls crystal clear, even in noise. In terms of design, the new metal blade adds a sophisticated look to Galaxy Buds4. With a translucent cover, Charging Case is compact for portability. Connectivity has also been improved with seamless pairing available on Galaxy devices running on One UI 8.5. You can also easily control from settings and Quick Panel without a separate app.16

    Galaxy Buds4 Pro has an enhanced 2-way Speaker and a Dual Amplifier to reproduce Hi-Fi sound thats true to the original recording. It also comes with 3 sets of silicone ear tips in different sizes for sound delivery with less distortion. Features such as Voice Detect and Siren Detect are supported on Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Galaxy Buds4, on the other hand, is optimised for everyday listening. It produces balanced & clear sound in studio quality, bringing you closer to your favourite artists.17

    In the box, you'll find a pair of your chosen Galaxy Buds4, a Charging Case and the Quick Start Guide. USB Type-C cable is not included.

    Galaxy Buds4 comes in two classic colours, White and Black. With timeless colours that never go out of style, Galaxy Buds4 blends into your outfit for any occasion.

    Yes, Galaxy Buds4 Charging Case support wireless charging. Wireless charging pad is not included in the box and is sold separately.

    Galaxy Buds4 Pro has an enhanced 2-way Speaker and a Dual Amplifier to reproduce Hi-Fi sound thats true to the original recording. It also comes with 3 sets of silicone ear tips in different sizes for sound delivery with less distortion. Features such as Voice Detect and Siren Detect are supported on Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Galaxy Buds4, on the other hand, is optimised for everyday listening. It produces balanced & clear sound in studio quality, bringing you closer to your favourite artists.18

    You can use Pinch Control on Galaxy Buds4 using your index finger. First, wear the earbuds and try the following actions. Pinch once (Single pinch) to play or pause the track, answer or end a call and stop using features such as Read Notifications Aloud. Pinch twice (Double pinch) to play the next track. Pinch three times (Triple pinch) to play the previous track. Pinch and hold to turn on the preset feature or decline a call. Swipe up or down using your index finger to adjust the volume.

    Samsung Seamless Codec (SSC) Ultra High Quality (UHQ) Audio Option allows you to listen to audio in full detail, with rich audio information. You can turn on SSC - UHQ option when Galaxy Buds4 Series is paired with an eligible Galaxy device. The audio is delivered in extended 24-bit bit depth and 96 kHz sampling rate.19

    SSC - UHQ supports up to 24-bit / 96 kHz and is available on Galaxy smartphones such as Galaxy S26 Series, S25 Series, S24 Series, S23 Series, Z Fold7, Z Flip7, Z Fold6, Z Flip6, Z Fold5 and Z Flip5. It's also available on Galaxy Tab S11 Series, Tab S10 Series and Tab S9 Series with One UI 6.1.1 or above. More devices may be supported in the future.20

    Galaxy Buds4 Series isolates your voice input through an advanced Deep Neural Network (DNN) technology. The conversation between the caller and receiver is delivered through Super Wideband (SWB) up to 16 kHz, making the call crystal clear.21

    To connect your Galaxy Buds4 to your Galaxy device, just open the Charging Case and the earbuds will automatically start pairing. A pop-up screen will appear on the Galaxy device. Tap Connect and the pairing is complete.22

    You can control Galaxy Buds4 based on the version of One UI on your Galaxy device. On Galaxy devices running on One UI 8.0 or later, certain features can be controlled from the Quick Panel or you can manage Galaxy Buds4 in more detail from your phone's device settings without downloading any additional apps. For Galaxy devices running on earlier versions of One UI, configurations can be found in the Galaxy Wearable app.23

    The Interpreter feature in Galaxy Buds4 allows you to keep listening. Your speech is delivered to your Samsung Galaxy smartphone to be interpreted and played through its speakers. Your opponent's speech is delivered to Samsung Galaxy smartphone to be interpreted, but will be played through the Galaxy Buds4 Series.24

    Auto Switch allows you to switch seamlessly between your devices. For instance, you can take incoming calls while you're working on a creative project on your Galaxy Tab or Galaxy Book. Once the call is over, you can go right back to your project effortlessly.25

    Purchased these for handsfree multi-tasking at work. A nice basic but sleek style. The sound quality has been fantastic - clear, noise cancellation, and plays my music perfectly. The battery has plenty of juice, and even after I use them for at least 9hrs per day, find that I only need to charge the case maybe once a week, possibly a week and a half, which is fantastic for those that forget to charge, unless you get a warning. As for comfort... I find it a little difficult due to having smaller than normal ear canals, so struggled for the first week trying to figure out how to keep them from falling out. Thankfully, I found the solution - pull down on the ear lobe, place the Galaxy Bud4 in, with the controller facing downwards, then turn it upwards towards your cheek, letting go of your earlobe, and find that sweet spot where you can go all day with next to no adjustments needed. The connectivity is also great, and I find that I can easily be at one end of our work building, with my phone at the other, and still manage to be connected and receive calls. The controllers were a little bit for me to get used to at first, as I was used to previous models that used a "tap" and "hold", but now find these a lot easier, controlling more than I could before. Overall a fantastic product, well worth the price.

    Thank you for taking the time to share your review regarding the fit and touch controls on your Galaxy Buds. To resolve the pinch-and-hold responsiveness and ensure consistent touch command performance, please follow these troubleshooting steps: • Reset Earbuds: Open the Galaxy Wearable app, navigate to Earbuds settings > Reset, and confirm 'Reset'. • Update Firmware: In the Galaxy Wearable app, go to Earbuds settings > Earbuds software update > Download and install to apply the latest touch control stability improvements. • Reconfigure Touch Controls: Under Touch controls in the Galaxy Wearable app, verify and assign your preferred 'Touch and hold' actions for each earbud.
